waivers.verdict: Bid $9 on Ollie Gordon as running-back insurance (drop Jakobi Meyers), and $3 to swap the Giants defense for the Bears. Kicker holds.

lineup.verdict: Hold the lineup as set. Jaylen Warren (Questionable, shoulder) is the one name to watch before Sunday, but nothing changes it yet.

trades.verdict: Offer Kirk Cousins to SchoaTime (roster 1) for Tony Pollard. If they say no, offer Cousins to ObiWanless for RJ Harvey instead.

inactives.verdict: Hold your lineup — nobody is ruled out. Jaylen Warren's questionable tag isn't costing him the start.

actions.name: Ollie Gordon

evidence.note: Achane tore his ACL in Week 3 and is out for the season; Gordon carried 17 times as Miami's lead back with Jaylen Wright out (foot), though Wright is listed ahead of him on the depth chart.

actions.why: Warren is Questionable and Charbonnet is still on PUP, so a fourth back is real insurance; Gordon doesn't start this week, so he's priced as a stash.

actions.message: Saw Baker's out at least three weeks — rough luck. Cousins can go straight into your SUPER_FLEX, and his bye isn't until 13, so he covers every week Baker misses. I'd take Tony Pollard for him; he's sitting on your bench behind Chase Brown and Price anyway.

evidence.note: Mayfield dislocated his thumb in Week 3, out at least three weeks. Pollard is Tennessee's lead back (17 carries, 4 catches in Week 3).

actions.why: Pollard is a starting back who sits on their bench; Cousins fills a hole they have for at least three weeks. A better return for Cousins than RJ Harvey, and it opens nothing on my calendar.

actions.message: Your SUPER_FLEX has been empty behind Burrow — Cousins is a plug-and-play veteran starter there. I'll take RJ Harvey off your bench in return; you're set at RB with Barkley and Walker anyway.

evidence.note: Harvey played 51% of Denver's snaps in the opener as the pass-catching back in a crowded room (Dobbins, Coleman); real role, just not the lead ball-carrier.

actions.why: Only if SchoaTime says no. ObiWanless still has an empty SUPER_FLEX, so Cousins has a second buyer, but Harvey is the weaker return.
